description: WHEN CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :357 with both criteria valid and the account deliberately MISMATCHED against the card, which is this folder's gate G45 headline. The operator types ACCTSIDI '00000000002' beside CARDSIDI '0683586198171516'; fixture row 1 records that card's CARD-ACCT-ID as '00000000027', account '00000000002' owns row 2's '0923877193247330' instead, and all fifty fixture accounts are distinct, so account-to-card is strictly 1:1 and the mismatch is genuine. The read succeeds regardless, because 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD keys on the sixteen-byte card number ALONE: :739's MOVE CC-ACCT-ID-N TO WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID is commented out, so WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID is never populated and the account never enters the key, and :752-754 takes DFHRESP(NORMAL) and sets FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT. A mismatched account is silently irrelevant - verified legacy behaviour preserved as found (practice B5), not a defect introduced. 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT at :779-812 is UNREACHABLE, the only occurrences of 9150 being its own two labels while 9000-READ-DATA at :726-730 performs 9100 alone, so the CARDAIX finder is NOT invoked and no CARDAIX input is declared: CARDAIX is a second finder over the one CARDDAT base cluster, never a second table. The expectations below prove the key - a translation that read on the account, or through CARDAIX, would return row 2's Enrico Rosenbaum expiring 2024-08-11 and differ in every projected field. ACCTSIDO echoes the REQUESTED account: :676-677's MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID overwrites the '00000000027' the previous turn carried, then :464-465 paints ACCTSIDO from CC-ACCT-ID. Two asymmetries are reproduced rather than normalised (B5): :676 moves the ALPHANUMERIC CC-ACCT-ID view where :717 moves the NUMERIC CC-CARD-NUM-N REDEFINES view, and the FILLER REDEFINES at :85-90 splits '2025-07-13' into year, month and day of which only EXPYEARO and EXPMONO exist, so the day is computed and never surfaced (gate G34). :596-602 captures the RECEIVE RESP and never tests it; that gap stays. This turn did not arrive from the card list - CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM 'COCRDSLC', CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET 'COCRDSL' - so :509-511 moves DFHBMFSE rather than DFHBMPRF and :526-530's DFHDFCOL does not fire; both are CCRDSLAI input-group items, so CardSelectControllerTest asserts them and only the fifteen xxxC and fifteen xxxH output items appear here. With neither filter NOT-OK nor BLANK the cursor EVALUATE at :514-524 falls to WHEN OTHER and lands on ACCTSIDL, and no DFHRED and no '*' is written even though the context IS re-entry, because :541-551 guards the asterisk on BLANK AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER together - the no-error side of gate G38. :562-566 then SETs CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, so the response context stays 1, and COMMON-RETURN at :394-406 returns the 160-byte commarea plus its 12-byte trailer under TRANSID('CCDL'): all state in the payload, none server-side (gate G37, rule R6). The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:16:00 - the version-footer stamp of app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy and app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, the two copybooks this case pins - so CURDATEO is '07/19/22' and CURTIMEO '23:16:00' every run (B7). The name says Select; the program is a detail VIEW, per its own :4 header, README.md:213-231 and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:220's DESCRIPTION(VIEW CARD DETAIL). Rule R1 keeps the mandated name and takes behaviour from the source, so the divergence is documented, not repaired (B4). Provenance (B12): derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl, the CVACT02Y byte layout, the COCRDSL.CPY xxxI PICTURE clauses, app/bms/COCRDSL.bms and the real ASCII fixture - never captured from a live COBOL execution, which plan 0.7.6 proves impossible here with eight blockers (risk R-A). Gates G32, G35 and G39 have no call site: all nine GO TOs here are forward early-exit or shared-terminal jumps and CBSTM03A alone forms backward loops; there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' in COCRDSLC, whose abend path is the CICS-native HANDLE ABEND into ABEND ABCODE('9999'); and the map declares no PAGENO.
